The four documents — claim, audit, claim, audit:  PSF = owner's project plan  ·  PVR = auditor A's design-audit report  ·  PMR = owner's measured results  ·  ERVR = auditor B's performance-audit report (carries the verified quantity)
The three rules that make a credit trustworthy & distinguish us
The party that audits a project's design is never the party that audits its performance — Certified Auditor vs Certified Creditor, at institution level.
The issued quantity is the Certified Creditor's recalculation — BE − PE − LE in tCO₂e under the pinned GWP set — checked for arithmetic consistency before any decision sees it.
No person can mint or un-retire. Every report, decision and confirmation is published to a blockchain-based public ledger, tamper-evident.
